Teach and record the rig-level permission policy. The team and kernel launch
defaults pass allow/ask lists per launch and save none; a selected Claude
settings fragment can merge native settings, rules included; the harness-native
permissions are the control surface. OpenRig records posture into RigSpec;
harness-native permissions enforce — never runtime enforcement. (The
context-mode verb formerly at this name is now: rig mode.)

store it on an existing seat. Restore, resume and launches that read the seat's
stored state use the stored policy, unless an explicit native selection (rig
seat set-permissions) takes precedence; `rig up <rig name>` uses it, while a
launch from a spec that declares a policy replaces it with the spec's policy,
which later restores then use. The team and kernel launch defaults pass
allow/ask lists per launch and save none; a selected Claude settings fragment
can merge native settings, rules included; the harness-native permissions are
the control surface. OpenRig records posture into RigSpec; harness-native
permissions enforce — never runtime enforcement.
